title: Export asset paths escape their project
cause: Client canvas assetId and name are interpolated into resolve(assetsDir, ...) without containment or membership validation.
evidence: API probe accepted ../../other/assets/audit. Renderer validation also accepted traversal and loadImage loaded an8×8 synthetic image outside the project (evidence/text-reproductions.txt). Full cross-account render not attempted.
repro: PATCH a disposable project with the traversal canvas element in evidence/reproduce.py; inspect resolved path in text-reproductions.json.
impact: A caller who knows a readable image path could incorporate another project’s image into their export. This is not arbitrary text-file disclosure or shell execution.
fix: Resolve opaque asset IDs through the current project asset manifest; reject separators, unknown IDs and paths outside a canonical project directory. Validate the complete element schema.
confidence: High; boundary acceptance and path escape reproduced
acceptance: Traversal, absolute paths, extension tricks and foreign assets rejected; own image export still works.
resolution: See priority-fixes.md; verified 2026-10-09.

title: Cancelled workers can overwrite a retried job
cause: Cancellation is keyed only by project ID and retry clears it before the old worker acknowledges cancellation.
evidence: Controlled threaded probe: cancel=200, retry=200, old worker wrote OLD RESULT and changed queued retry to ready.
repro: Run evidence/reproduce.py; it blocks a fake decoder, cancels, retries, then releases the old decoder.
impact: Stale captions are presented as a successful new run; overlapping workers can remove each other’s audio and cancellation flag.
fix: Assign a generation/job ID; compare it on every progress/result write; keep cancelling state until acknowledgement and reject stale commits.
acceptance: Old worker cannot write status, words or clean up the new generation’s resources after retry.
resolution: See priority-fixes.md; verified 2026-10-09.

title: Native Hindi routes to Apple-only MLX on Linux
cause: The Sherpa fallback is hardcoded to mlx, independent of platform; Linux requirements exclude mlx-whisper.
evidence: decode_plan(..., native, False) returns mlx and the Turbo repo; requirements contain Darwin/arm64 marker. No Linux inference was run.
repro: Call decode_plan with Sherpa/native on a Linux-target configuration.
impact: Native Hindi and English translation fail on the configured Sherpa Linux deployment path.
fix: Choose a supported backend by platform/capability and validate model availability before accepting the job.
confidence: High; dispatch reproduced, deployment failure inferred
acceptance: Linux configuration selects installed faster-whisper; Mac can select MLX; an unavailable engine fails before queuing.
resolution: See next-priority-fixes.md; verified 2026-10-09.

title: Translation selects a model not trained for translation
cause: Default multilingual model is large-v3-turbo and task=translate is passed to it.
evidence: Dispatch reproduced. OpenAI Whisper README explicitly says Turbo is not trained for translation; live translated audio was not evaluated.
repro: Enable translation with default MLX model or default portable Turbo configuration.
impact: English translation cannot be relied on; source-language words may be labelled as translated.
fix: Use a validated translation-capable checkpoint, separate task capability from engine selection, and add bilingual acceptance fixtures.
confidence: High; source and upstream capability evidence
acceptance: Non-English fixture produces checked English content; translation failure never masquerades as successful source transcription.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Supported translation model/task routing and immutable pins tested; held-out translation/alignment evaluation unavailable. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Autosave omits optimistic-concurrency revision
cause: Backend revision guard is optional and flushSave does not send revision despite receiving it.
evidence: API probe: stale write without revision=200; same stale revision=409. Source flushSave body contains no revision.
repro: Open two clients, edit in A, then submit older whole-project state from B.
impact: One tab silently overwrites another tab’s words/settings.
fix: Send revision; preserve unsaved local state on 409 and offer compare/reload or explicit overwrite.
acceptance: Two-client stale update is rejected and local unsaved edits remain recoverable.
resolution: See priority-fixes.md; verified 2026-10-09.

title: Placed video and primary media changes do not match export
cause: Placed assets use loadImage, failures are silently ignored, and rendering uses source.bin rather than the editor’s active media selection.
evidence: Preload loop only decodes images; frame compositor reads loadedCanvasImages. Main editor has separate video/active-media paths.
repro: Add a video overlay or switch primary displayed media; compare preview and downloaded MP4. Not executed in browser.
impact: An apparently successful export can omit visible media; project style parity does not imply scene parity.
fix: Define one persisted scene graph and use time-aware video decoding, z-order and chromakey consistently in preview/export; reject unsupported layers visibly.
confidence: High for image-only export branch; composite scenarios unverified
acceptance: Golden exports cover image/video overlay, selected primary media, rotation, z-order and chromakey at multiple timestamps.
resolution: See media-parity-fixes.md; synthetic frame, audio and browser verification on 2026-10-09.

title: Audio download bypasses authentication and API origin
cause: A raw relative anchor is used instead of API_BASE and authorized download helpers. The signed-media allowlist also omits /audio.
evidence: Source at downloadAudioTrack; auth middleware only permits signed tokens on specified media routes. Local unauthenticated API audio tests pass and do not cover this.
repro: Use Audio .M4A on an account-enabled deployment with separate backend origin.
impact: The UI announces download started although the protected request fails.
fix: Fetch an authenticated blob or add a scoped audio-token route and build its URL through the API helper; announce success after response.
acceptance: Valid account downloads audio; expired session refreshes; another account cannot download it.
resolution: See next-priority-fixes.md; verified 2026-10-09.

title: Responsive toolbars clip essential actions
cause: Fixed-width toolbar contents exceed available width while ancestors hide overflow.
evidence: Eleven widths measured in evidence/responsive.json; screenshot editor-320.png shows clipped Export and timeline actions.
repro: Open six-word fixture at 320/375/390/428/600/900/1024 px.
impact: Export is clipped at 320/375; timeline search/fullscreen and other controls leave the viewport at additional widths.
fix: Reflow toolbars or provide a reachable overflow menu; preserve visible primary actions and keyboard focus.
acceptance: All requested widths expose every action without hidden focus or page-level horizontal overflow; recheck populated and empty states.
resolution: See ui-fixes.md; browser verified 2026-10-09.

title: Typing a question mark opens shortcuts
cause: The ? shortcut is handled before the editable-target guard. Cmd+Z/B ordering has the same source-level concern.
evidence: Browser focused Project name, pressed ?, and Keyboard Shortcuts opened.
repro: Focus a name or caption text input and type ?.
impact: Normal text entry is interrupted; native editing shortcuts can be intercepted.
fix: Apply editable-target detection before global editing/help commands, allowing only explicitly intended shortcuts.
acceptance: Typing punctuation and native undo work in input, textarea and contenteditable; help shortcut works outside them.
resolution: See ui-fixes.md; browser verified 2026-10-09.

title: Timeline find-and-replace button opens nothing
cause: Button toggles showSearchBar used only for active styling; it does not open the existing search-replace modal.
evidence: Browser click produced no search UI; source references consist of state, class and setter.
repro: Click timeline Search and replace.
impact: A labelled action appears to work but does not enable the task.
fix: Wire the button to the shared search-replace modal and remove unused state.
acceptance: Button opens the same functional dialog as the command palette.
resolution: See ui-fixes.md; browser verified 2026-10-09.

title: Safe-area command writes an unused setting
cause: Command writes showSafeArea while preview uses safeAreaFor(settings.safeArea).
evidence: Command source lines 152–160 compared with main safeArea memo.
repro: Run Show Safe Area Guides in Cmd+K.
impact: Command changes state without showing the advertised guides; tour overstates guaranteed protection.
fix: Write an explicit safeArea enum and use accurate Reels/Shorts names; remove obsolete flag.
acceptance: Palette and Text panel show identical selected platform and rendered zones.
resolution: See ui-fixes.md; browser verified 2026-10-09.

title: Joined captions bypass the seven-word ceiling
cause: If a no-break chain exceeds maxWords, dynamic programming leaves from[n]=0 and emits the whole chain.
evidence: Twelve joined words produced one twelve-word page in text-reproductions.json.
repro: Set lineBreak=false across twelve consecutive words and buildPages(words,7).
impact: Long merged lines can overrun layout and contradict the documented maximum.
fix: Specify whether user joins override the ceiling; either constrain merges or provide a deterministic legal fallback.
acceptance: Overlong joins never silently violate the agreed ceiling and preserve every word exactly once.
resolution: See caption-reliability-fixes.md; tests and synthetic browser verification on 2026-10-09.

title: Editor can create settings the server rejects
cause: Linked size ratio can produce heroFontSize>200; preview positioning permits values below backend position minimum10.
evidence: API probes return422 for position4 and heroFontSize300; source controls allow these values.
repro: Drag project captions near top edge or increase linked caption size at high hero ratio.
impact: Autosave fails after a valid-looking gesture, leaving work unsaved.
fix: Share bounds and clamp linked quantities as a pair; expose a valid drag range.
acceptance: Every value produced by UI controls round-trips through backend validation.
resolution: See caption-reliability-fixes.md; tests and synthetic browser verification on 2026-10-09.

title: Vocal isolation is unused by MLX and faster-whisper decoding
cause: Separated samples replace audio in memory but file-based decoders receive the original audio_path.
evidence: Sherpa receives audio array; both other branches transcribe str(audio_path).
repro: Enable isolation with MLX/faster-whisper and inspect decoder input using a stub.
impact: User pays separation time without recognition using the cleaned signal; boundary/emphasis analysis uses a different signal.
fix: Pass the processed array where supported or write a scoped processed WAV, with explicit provenance and cleanup.
acceptance: All engines consume the chosen signal; failed separation reports fallback and never prevents ordinary transcription.
resolution: See isolation-signal-fixes.md; decoder input and temporary-file lifecycle verified on 2026-10-10.

title: Saved overlay URLs expire with their signatures
cause: Canvas elements persist source URLs rather than reconstructing them from asset IDs and fresh authorization.
evidence: Canvas src is assigned from mediaUrl and saved in project canvasElements; token TTL is two hours.
repro: Save an asset layer, reopen after its signed URL expires. Not elapsed-time tested.
impact: Previously saved overlays can disappear while project media itself refreshes correctly.
fix: Persist IDs and relative asset references; generate current URLs when loading/rendering.
acceptance: A project opened after token expiry/restart reloads all authorized overlays.
resolution: See media-link-fixes.md; token lifecycle tests and obsolete saved URL browser verification on 2026-10-10.

title: Queue and storage do not survive scaled deployment safely
cause: ThreadPoolExecutor queue and RLock are process-local; JSON files lack multi-process transactions; restart marks jobs failed.
evidence: Source review; no restart/load test performed against user data.
repro: Run two worker processes or restart during a queued job in staging.
impact: Lost jobs, stale writes and capacity contention between rendering and speech processing.
fix: Keep one process as an explicit supported mode now; add bounded durable jobs, job leases and transactional project storage before scaling.
acceptance: Restart-safe jobs, bounded queue, tenant limits and duplicate-delivery-safe writes proven in staging.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: SQLite accepted-job journal, bounded replay, cancelled/deleted/completed fences and exclusive-store process guard verified. Distributed transactional storage/leases remain unsupported. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Media admission lacks quotas and full asset constraints
cause: Upload loop byte cap follows multipart parsing; assets lack primary-media dimension/duration caps; job queue is unbounded.
evidence: Source inspection. No oversized or exhaustion attack performed.
repro: Use small boundary fixtures and mocked limits; separately test multipart admission at reverse proxy.
impact: Authenticated or unauthenticated deployments may exhaust disk, memory or worker capacity.
fix: Enforce request-body cap upstream, per-owner storage/concurrency budgets, bounded queue and consistent media limits.
acceptance: Over-budget requests fail before spooling/queuing, cleanup is verified and other users remain responsive.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Body/part/header/global/owner/storage/media/typed canvas/derived output limits and renderer workload preflight tested; watchdog sampling and codec-memory limits disclosed. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Custom dialogs and drag controls lack consistent keyboard support
cause: Some dialogs bypass shared Modal focus management; word insertion is removed from Tab order and drag operations lack equivalent controls.
evidence: Source review; common Modal is stronger than custom implementations. No assistive-technology certification.
repro: Tab/Shift+Tab through palette, tour and media dialogs; operate word insertion/movement without a pointer.
impact: Focus can leave dialogs or reach background; editing requires a pointer.
fix: Reuse Modal, label dialogs and controls, return focus, and supply keyboard move/insert commands.
confidence: High for missing implementation; full AT behavior unverified
acceptance: Keyboard-only completion of editing/media dialogs with contained focus and restored trigger; screen-reader smoke test.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Dialog trap/restore/one-modal gating, keyboard insertion/move/canvas size-position and exact Undo/Redo verified; screen-reader/platform matrix remains pending. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Application suppresses browser zoom
cause: Ctrl-wheel and Ctrl +/-/0 are prevented globally.
evidence: Source-verified prevention logic; browser zoom was not force-changed during audit.
repro: Attempt browser zoom shortcuts while editing.
impact: Low-vision users lose expected browser magnification; timeline zoom conflicts with browser conventions.
fix: Scope timeline gestures to the timeline and leave browser zoom shortcuts intact.
acceptance: 200% text resize and 400% reflow work; timeline zoom retains accessible alternatives.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Browser modifier zoom keys pass through all global/canvas handlers; in-app browser does not provide genuine 200%/400% magnification testing. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Locked npm and installed PyJWT versions have advisories
cause: npm scan reports source-map-js1.2.1 and fast-uri3.1.7; OSV selected-package scan flags PyJWT2.14.0.
evidence: evidence/npm-audit.json, python-advisories.json and dependency-security.md.
repro: Repeat advisory queries against the recorded graph; do not infer exploitability from severity alone.
impact: Maintenance exposure; observed first-party paths do not establish public exploitability of these advisories.
fix: Update through compatible patched versions, lock Python dependencies, rerun build/auth/render tests and scan deployment image.
confidence: High version match; application reachability limited
acceptance: No affected recorded versions remain; auth constraints and render/build behavior still pass.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: fast-uri3.1.8/source-map-js1.2.2/PyJWT2.15.1 installed; npm0 advisories and16 selected Python versionsOSV0 advisories; PyJWT floor2.15. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Inline group editing rewrites timing and word metadata
cause: Group text replacement redistributes timing and recreates word records; display rounds timing to tenths.
evidence: Source-reviewed edit callbacks and main group replacement path.
repro: Edit only group spelling on irregularly timed words with emphasis/glossary metadata; compare before/after.
impact: Manual corrections may change synchronization and lose provenance or emphasis.
fix: Preserve matched IDs and timings; make retiming explicit, distinguish estimated timings and keep raw precision separate from display.
confidence: High data-flow; interactive scenario not replayed
acceptance: Spelling-only edits preserve unaffected timing/metadata; insertions explain estimated boundaries.
resolution: See caption-reliability-fixes.md; tests and synthetic browser verification on 2026-10-09.

title: Find count and replacement use different matching rules
cause: Dialog counts substring matches while helper replaces exact normalized words; blank replacement can create invalid empty text.
evidence: Compare StudioModals count with captions.ts replaceAllOccurrences.
repro: Find a substring inside a longer word, then replace; try empty replacement in disposable data.
impact: Reported matches need not change; a blank replacement may make save fail.
fix: Share matcher between count and execution; support explicit delete or reject empty replacement.
acceptance: Count equals replacements; punctuation/case/empty replacement fixtures pass.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Matching/count/Next/All use shared trimmed whole-word rules; blank replacement guarded; punctuation/case tests pass. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: PATCH accepts translation options but does not persist them
cause: Schema declares emoji and translate but patch handler applies neither.
evidence: Probe PATCH translate=true returns200 with translate absent. TranscribeRequest path does apply it.
repro: PATCH a project with translate=true or emoji=true and reread.
impact: API clients receive success for ignored changes.
fix: Persist declared fields or reject unsupported PATCH inputs; keep generation request semantics explicit.
acceptance: Every declared mutable field round-trips or returns a documented rejection.
resolution: See next-priority-fixes.md; verified 2026-10-09.

title: VTT and CSV escape syntax incompletely
cause: VTT injects raw caption text; CSV quoting does not neutralize spreadsheet formulas.
evidence: Probe produces raw <test>& in VTT and quoted =1+1 CSV cell. Spreadsheet execution not performed.
repro: Export captions containing markup delimiters or leading formula characters.
impact: VTT players may interpret text as markup; spreadsheet consumers may evaluate user-authored cell text.
fix: Escape VTT cue text; offer safe spreadsheet text escaping with documented round-trip behavior.
confidence: High output evidence; target-editor behavior not tested
acceptance: Literal angle brackets/ampersands display correctly; formula-like words open as text in supported spreadsheets.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: VTT escapes markup and prevents injected cue newlines; CSV neutralizes formula-like fields; exact text remains available inJSON. Target spreadsheet/player matrix not certified. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Playback and workspace polling scale with whole transcripts
cause: Full projects and words are polled; every caption row participates in playback-driven rendering; no transcript virtualization.
evidence: Source structure; bundle measured separately. No long-transcript latency benchmark.
repro: Profile long synthetic transcript and many disposable projects.
impact: Payload, render work and memory grow with history and transcript size.
fix: Use summary listing/pagination, targeted job polling and memoized/virtualized caption rows after profiling.
confidence: High design evidence; quantitative impact unmeasured
acceptance: Record bounded payload and responsive playback on agreed long-transcript fixture.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: 100 caption rows/200 timelinegroups/bounded ruler, sampled clock and summaries/export-only polls verified. Full-session device profiler and remaining scans not certified. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Model artifacts and accuracy claims are not reproducibly validated
cause: Default model downloads lack pinned revisions; companion may run a second full pass; no consented held-out corpus is supplied.
evidence: Preparation scripts allow revisions but runtime defaults do not enforce them; benchmark excludes failures from score means.
repro: Record actual revisions, task settings, failures and correction/timing errors on a held-out corpus.
impact: Quality changes cannot be attributed reliably; benchmark averages can hide failures.
fix: Pin artifacts, persist engine/task/revision/preprocessing metadata, report failures and evaluate code-switching/timing separately.
confidence: High evidence; no fresh accuracy metric claimed
acceptance: Reproducible run metadata and failure-inclusive evaluation with human references.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Immutable defaultmodelpins, localhashmanifests, primary/companionprovenance, failure-inclusive benchmark coverage verified. Existing assetupstream revisionunknown and qualitycorpus pending. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Drag history may capture the already-dragged state
cause: Continuous drag updates pass history=false; final update records the state after intermediate mutations rather than the original drag snapshot.
evidence: Source callback ordering. Full pointer drag/undo reproduction not completed.
repro: Drag a word through multiple events, release, undo once; compare exact starting timing.
impact: Undo can appear ineffective or restore only the last movement.
fix: Capture one immutable pre-drag snapshot and commit a single history entry at pointerup.
acceptance: One drag equals one undo step and restores exact original state.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Pre-drag scene committedonce; pointerdragUndo, keyboardcanvasrapidUndo/Redo and StrictMode side-effect removal verified. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: New overlays use undeclared tokens and CSS contains invalid declarations
cause: Several new rules fall back to fixed dark colors via undefined --color-surface/--color-text; some background declarations have an extra parenthesis.
evidence: Complete CSS review; token references and declaration syntax checked.
repro: Inspect light-theme shortcuts/tour and CSS parsing diagnostics.
impact: Theme inconsistency and ignored styling; stylesheet is difficult to maintain.
fix: Use existing semantic tokens; remove invalid/dead declarations after screenshot comparison.
acceptance: Both themes use defined tokens, CSS parser reports no syntax issues, visual regressions reviewed.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Malformed CSS/static missing tokens/hover contrast repaired; light/dark shortcuts evidence reviewed. Not all color interactions exhaustively certified. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Job diagnostics do not provide a complete trace or recovery policy
cause: Progress is persisted as messages, but there is no correlation trace, structured stage timing, queue metrics or alert pipeline.
evidence: Source review; export logs are local and errors are partly generic.
repro: Induce extraction, decode, storage and render failures in staging.
impact: Support cannot reliably separate model startup, queue delay and processing failure.
fix: Add job/generation IDs, stage durations/error categories, bounded logs, redaction and recovery playbooks.
acceptance: Each failed job identifies stage/category/retry action without logging private transcript or tokens.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: Journal-correlatedjobIDs/queuedelay/stagetiming/category/retry records, output/logbounds/redaction/recovery tested. Production alerting/retention/backuprestore pending. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.

title: Product guidance overstates features and historical guarantees
cause: Historical claims include15-minute tokens, complete reduced-motion treatment, absent projects entry, and guaranteed safe-area protection; current code differs.
evidence: Current TTL2h, projects restored, partial motion overrides and visual-only safe areas.
repro: Compare current UI/config to those passages.
impact: Future development can reintroduce mistakes by treating historical descriptions as current contracts.
fix: Keep changelog historical but label current context and capability limitations in project brain; qualify local/cloud storage wording.
acceptance: Current operational docs agree with code and separate prior observations from current evidence.
resolution: Final team pass 2026-10-10: README/onboarding/design/history corrected; dated project-brain chapters explicitly link currentoperations; originalaudit evidence preserved. See FINAL_REAUDIT.md.
